title: Mater
description: This resource pack modifies the totem of undying
body:
This resource pack replaces the Totem of Immortality with a Meter from the cartoon "Cars"! Now, instead of the usual totem, you will have a funny and stylish Meter that not only resurrects, but also saves from death (for example, it gives temporary protection).

What has changed:

New texture – The Totem now looks like a Meter!

Improved functionality – death protection + classic resurrection.

A fun visual is perfect for fans of "Cars" and unusual texture packs.

The author promises to add new features based on the most popular comments, so please like and subscribe!

A great choice for those who want to spice up the gameplay with a reference to their favorite cartoon!
